metadata.description: Digital business cards, lead capture forms, and service listings - built and managed by AI

plugins.name: digital-business-card
plugins.description: Build a complete digital business card from a website URL. Scrapes content, searches stock photos, and creates a published card with hero, about, gallery, social links, contact buttons, and more. Supports 3 themes, 20+ field types, vCard, NFC, and live editing. Requires YesHello MCP server at https://yeshello.app/api/mcp
